name: Data Science & Machine Learning
description: Learn Data Science and Machine Learning in Jaipur with Python, statistics, data preparation, visualisation, predictive modelling, clustering and model evaluation at Groot Academy.
intro: Move from raw data to explainable analysis and evaluated machine-learning models. This path combines Python, statistics, visualisation and predictive methods, making it distinct from Data Analytics, which focuses more heavily on reporting, dashboards and business analysis.
audience: Students, graduates and professionals interested in data work. Basic Python and school-level mathematics are useful; review these foundations before the modelling modules.
modules: Python and data preparation
Use Python to work with datasets, identify missing values and prepare usable inputs for analysis.
Statistics and probability
Explore distributions, descriptive statistics, probability and the interpretation of relationships in data.
Exploratory analysis
Use visualisations to investigate patterns, communicate findings and identify data-quality issues.
Supervised learning
Study regression and decision trees and learn how predictions relate to input features.
Unsupervised learning and forecasting
Explore K-means clustering, market basket analysis and introductory time-series concepts.
Evaluation and applications
Compare model results, identify limitations and explore how machine learning and neural networks are applied to real problems.
projects: Exploratory data report
Clean a dataset, produce visualisations and explain the findings and limitations.
Prediction or clustering study
Build a small model and document its inputs, evaluation method and results.
faq: How is Data Science different from Data Analytics?

Data Analytics focuses mainly on querying, reporting, dashboards and communicating business findings. Data Science adds deeper statistical modelling and machine-learning methods for prediction and pattern discovery.
Is this also the preferred page for broad AI and Machine Learning course searches?

For now, broad predictive-AI and Machine Learning intent is consolidated here to avoid creating an overlapping AI page. Generative AI, prompt engineering and LLM application intent belongs on the dedicated Generative AI course page.

name: Data Analytics with Python & Power BI
description: Learn Data Analytics in Jaipur with Excel, SQL, Python, statistics, Tableau, Power BI and DAX for practical business reporting and dashboard projects at Groot Academy.
intro: Turn business questions into clear analysis, reports and dashboards. Work through data cleaning, Excel, SQL, Python, statistics and business-intelligence tools, while keeping this page focused on analyst and reporting workflows rather than machine-learning model development.
audience: Students, graduates and working professionals interested in analytical work. Basic computer and spreadsheet familiarity helps; programming topics start with Python foundations.
modules: Statistics for analysis
Explore descriptive statistics, distributions, correlation, sampling and hypothesis-testing concepts.
Excel and data cleaning
Use formulas, validation, pivot tables and charts to prepare and explore tabular data.
SQL
Query and combine relational data to answer analytical questions.
Python foundations
Practise Python basics and apply programmatic workflows to data preparation and analysis.
Visual analytics
Choose charts, filters and calculations for useful Tableau and Power BI reports.
Power BI reporting
Work with table relationships, DAX, dashboards and publishing workflows.
projects: Business analysis workbook
Clean a dataset, create a pivot-based summary and explain the business findings.
Interactive reporting dashboard
Build a dashboard with clear measures and filters, and present the decisions it supports.
faq: How is Data Analytics different from Data Science?
Data Analytics focuses on cleaning, querying, reporting, dashboards and communicating findings. Data Science goes further into predictive modelling and machine-learning techniques.
Does this Data Analytics course include Power BI?
Yes. The learning path includes Power BI relationships, DAX, reports and dashboards. Learners who want a narrower business-intelligence focus can also review the dedicated Power BI course page.

name: Power BI & Business Intelligence
description: Explore Power BI training in Jaipur with data relationships, DAX, visualisations, reports, dashboards and publishing at Groot Academy.
intro: Build reports that make business data easier to understand. Focus on the Power BI modules from the analytics learning path: relationships, calculations, visualisations, dashboards and publishing.
audience: Spreadsheet users, students and professionals who want to create business reports. Familiarity with rows, columns and basic formulas is helpful.
modules: Power BI foundations
Understand the reporting workflow and the role of Power BI components.
Data and relationships
Organise related tables and understand how relationships affect report results.
DAX calculations
Introduce DAX functions and calculations used to produce meaningful business measures.
Visualisations and reports
Choose suitable visuals, configure report pages and use filtering to support exploration.
Dashboards and tiles
Organise key information into a dashboard and distinguish it from a report.
Publishing and workspaces
Explore report publishing and workspace workflows, including how to review outputs before sharing.
projects: Business performance report
Create a report with clearly defined measures and drill into the drivers of a result.
Dashboard presentation
Summarise the key findings for a business audience and explain the data assumptions.
faq: Do I need Python for Power BI?
Python is not needed to begin the Power BI reporting modules. Spreadsheet familiarity and an understanding of data relationships are more directly useful at the start.

name: Generative AI & AI Tools
description: Learn Generative AI in Jaipur with prompt engineering, LLM concepts, Python, APIs, retrieval workflows, AI assistants and output evaluation at Groot Academy.
intro: Learn how to use and build with Generative AI: define tasks, design prompts, work with language-model APIs and evaluate outputs. This page targets LLM, prompt-engineering and AI-application intent, while predictive modelling and traditional Machine Learning stay on the Data Science and Machine Learning page.
audience: Beginners can start with AI tools and prompting. Learners who want to build applications should add Python and API foundations.
modules: AI and language model foundations
Distinguish using an AI tool from building an application connected to a model.
Prompt design
Describe goals, context, audience, output format and constraints, then improve results through iteration.
Python and API foundations
Work with files and data and understand how applications send requests and receive model responses.
Application concepts
Explore structured outputs, tool calling, embeddings and retrieval-based workflows.
AI-assisted workflows
Design a chatbot, content assistant or document question-answering prototype around a clear task.
Evaluation and responsible use
Test relevance and accuracy, protect sensitive data and identify situations requiring human review.
projects: Information chatbot
Create a small assistant that answers a defined set of questions and test its limitations.
Document assistant prototype
Connect a document workflow to AI and evaluate answers against the source material.
faq: Is coding required to start Generative AI?
You can begin with AI tools and prompt engineering without coding. Python and API skills become important when you want to build custom assistants, integrations or automation.
How is Generative AI different from Data Science and Machine Learning?

Generative AI focuses on language models, prompting, APIs and applications that generate or transform content. Data Science and Machine Learning focus more on data analysis, predictive models, clustering and model evaluation.

name: Cloud Computing & AWS
description: Learn Cloud Computing and AWS in Jaipur with Linux, EC2, S3, networking, security, deployment, monitoring and practical cloud labs at Groot Academy.
intro: Build practical cloud foundations before moving into AWS services. Work with Linux, compute, storage, networking, access concepts, deployment and monitoring so the page serves both Cloud Computing and AWS training intent without splitting them across duplicate landing pages.
audience: Students and beginners interested in cloud infrastructure. Basic computer skills are a starting point; Linux and networking foundations are part of the path.
modules: Cloud service models
Understand cloud fundamentals and the roles of infrastructure, platform and software as a service.
Linux foundations
Practise the operating-system skills needed to work with servers.
AWS compute and storage
Explore EC2 instances and S3 storage through small hosting and storage tasks.
Networking and security
Understand how cloud resources communicate and review access and security fundamentals.
Application deployment
Follow a basic workflow for hosting a website or deploying a web application.
Monitoring
Observe server and application behaviour and document a cloud project.
projects: Website hosting project
Host a static website and explain the storage and access choices.
Application deployment lab
Deploy a small web application and demonstrate basic monitoring.
faq: Does this course cover AWS as well as cloud computing fundamentals?
Yes. The path begins with cloud and Linux foundations, then uses AWS services such as EC2 and S3 alongside networking, deployment and monitoring practice.
Is this an AWS certification guarantee?
No. This page describes practical Cloud Computing and AWS training. Ask the team whether the current batch includes certification-specific preparation; no exam result is guaranteed.

name: Cyber Security
description: Explore cyber security training in Jaipur with networking, Linux, web security, OWASP concepts, vulnerability assessment and reporting in authorised labs.
intro: Learn to recognise security weaknesses and communicate how to address them. Build networking and Linux foundations, then practise web security concepts, assessment and reporting in authorised lab environments.
audience: Students and beginners interested in defensive security. Networking and Linux fundamentals provide the foundation for later security exercises.
modules: Cyber security foundations
Understand common security risks and the importance of permission and scope in security work.
Networking fundamentals
Explore how devices communicate and investigate network behaviour in a lab.
Linux for security
Practise Linux skills used to inspect and manage a controlled security environment.
Web security
Study web security basics and OWASP concepts using deliberately configured exercises.
Vulnerability assessment
Review an authorised lab application and organise findings by their practical impact.
Security reporting
Document evidence, remediation recommendations and a capstone security checklist.
projects: Network analysis lab
Examine traffic in a controlled environment and explain the observations.
Web security report
Produce an assessment report for an authorised practice application, including remediation advice.
faq: Where will security exercises take place?
Practise only in authorised labs and systems for which permission has been granted. The learning path focuses on understanding weaknesses, reporting them and improving defences.

name: Flutter App Development
description: Learn Flutter app development in Jaipur with Dart, widgets, navigation, Firebase, location features, testing and publishing at Groot Academy.
intro: Build mobile interfaces with Flutter and connect them to useful application features. Begin with Dart, then progress through widgets, navigation, Firebase, location-aware features and app testing.
audience: Students and aspiring mobile developers. Begin with Dart syntax and programming concepts before moving into Flutter application development.
modules: Dart foundations
Learn Dart syntax, functions and object-oriented programming.
Flutter foundations
Understand the Flutter application structure and work with fundamental widgets.
Navigation and interaction
Connect screens with navigation and routing and add interactive behaviour.
Rich interfaces
Use visual, behavioural and motion-rich widgets to improve the app experience.
Connected and location-aware features
Explore Firebase integration and location-aware applications using GPS and maps.
Testing and publishing
Test app behaviour and review the steps involved in preparing an application for publishing.
projects: Multi-screen mobile app
Build a Flutter application with clear navigation and reusable widgets.
Connected application prototype
Add a Firebase-backed feature or location-aware screen, then document and test the workflow.
faq: Will I learn Dart as well as Flutter?
Yes. The learning path starts with Dart syntax, functions and object-oriented programming before progressing to Flutter widgets and application features.

name: Digital Marketing
description: Learn Digital Marketing in Jaipur with SEO, Google Ads and PPC concepts, social media, content, email marketing, analytics and practical campaign planning at Groot Academy.
intro: Connect a marketing goal with the right audience, channel and measurement plan. Practise SEO, paid-search concepts, social media, content, email and analytics as one coordinated marketing workflow instead of splitting each channel into thin duplicate course pages.
audience: Students, professionals, freelancers and business owners interested in marketing. Prior coding experience is not required; curiosity and regular practice are useful.
modules: Digital strategy
Understand customer behaviour, campaign goals and how to measure and improve marketing performance.
Search engine optimisation
Explore how content and website improvements support search visibility.
Search and paid campaigns
Study SEM and PPC concepts, ad planning and the role of Google Ads.
Social and content marketing
Plan content for social platforms, blogs and video around audience needs.
Email and inbound marketing
Explore email campaigns, audience relationships and content-led enquiry generation.
Measurement and optimisation
Use analytics concepts to interpret website and campaign results and recommend improvements.
projects: Marketing campaign plan
Create an audience-focused plan with channel choices, content ideas and measurable objectives.
SEO and performance review
Review a sample website and report opportunities, measurements and recommended next steps.
faq: Can someone without a technical background join the Digital Marketing course?
Yes. The learning path is suitable for students, professionals, freelancers and business owners and does not require prior coding experience.
Does the course include SEO, PPC and social media marketing?
The learning path covers SEO, paid-search and PPC concepts, social media, content, email and analytics. Confirm the exact tools and campaign exercises included in the selected batch.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: Learn Artificial Intelligence in Jaipur with AI foundations, problem framing, supervised and unsupervised learning, neural-network concepts, evaluation and practical AI workflows at Groot Academy.
intro: Understand how artificial-intelligence systems are designed, trained and evaluated, then connect those ideas to practical use cases. This page focuses on broad AI concepts and applied machine learning; the Data Science course goes deeper into analytics and modelling workflows, while the Generative AI course focuses on LLMs, prompting and AI assistants.
audience: Students, graduates and professionals who want a structured introduction to AI. Basic Python and school-level mathematics are helpful before moving into model-building topics.
modules: Artificial Intelligence foundations
Understand AI terminology, common problem types and how rule-based, machine-learning and generative systems differ.
Data and problem framing
Translate a real-world task into inputs, outputs, constraints and measurable success criteria before choosing a model.
Supervised learning
Explore classification and regression concepts, features, labels, training data and validation.
Unsupervised learning
Study clustering and pattern-discovery approaches and when they are useful.
Neural-network concepts
Learn the role of layers, activations, training and overfitting at an introductory level.
Evaluation and responsible use
Compare outputs with suitable metrics, identify limitations and understand where human review is necessary.
projects: AI classification prototype
Prepare a small dataset, train a simple model and explain the evaluation results.
Applied AI case study
Define an AI problem for a practical domain and document the data, model choice, risks and success criteria.
faq: How is this Artificial Intelligence course different from Data Science?

Artificial Intelligence focuses on building systems that perform tasks such as prediction, classification and decision support. Data Science includes broader data preparation, analysis, statistics and modelling workflows.
How is this different from Generative AI?
This course covers broad AI and machine-learning foundations. Generative AI focuses more specifically on language models, prompting, retrieval and AI-assistant applications.

name: Business Analytics
description: Learn Business Analytics in Jaipur with Excel, SQL, KPIs, data interpretation, dashboards, Power BI and decision-focused reporting at Groot Academy.
intro: Learn to turn business questions into measurable KPIs, structured analysis and clear recommendations. This course is intentionally decision-focused: Data Analytics covers broader technical analysis workflows, while Business Analytics emphasises business context, reporting, stakeholder questions and actionable insight.
audience: Students, graduates, business professionals and aspiring analysts who want to use data for decision-making. Spreadsheet familiarity is useful but advanced programming is not required to begin.
modules: Business questions and KPIs
Convert business goals into measurable questions, metrics and reporting requirements.
Excel for analysis
Use formulas, lookups, pivots and charts to explore operational and business data.
SQL for business reporting
Query, filter, aggregate and combine data to answer business questions.
Analytics and interpretation
Compare trends, segments and drivers while separating observation from unsupported conclusions.
Power BI dashboards
Build measures, relationships and interactive reports for decision support.
Data storytelling
Present findings with context, assumptions, limitations and practical recommendations.
projects: Business performance dashboard
Build a KPI dashboard for sales, operations or marketing data and explain the key changes.
Decision-support analysis
Answer a defined business question using structured data, charts and a concise recommendation.
faq: How is Business Analytics different from Data Analytics?

Business Analytics puts more emphasis on business questions, KPIs, stakeholders and decision support. Data Analytics typically goes deeper into technical data preparation, querying and analytical workflows.
Does this course include Power BI?
Yes. Power BI is used for relationships, measures, reports and dashboard-based decision support.

name: UI/UX Design
description: Learn UI/UX Design in Jaipur with user research, information architecture, wireframing, Figma, responsive UI, prototyping, design systems, usability testing and portfolio projects at Groot Academy.
intro: Learn the complete UI/UX workflow from understanding users and structuring information to wireframes, interface design, Figma prototypes, responsive layouts, design systems and usability testing. Build practical project work that shows both design thinking and execution.
audience: Students, beginners, graduates, graphic designers, web designers, developers, freelancers, digital marketers, entrepreneurs and working professionals. Advanced coding knowledge is not required.
modules: UI/UX fundamentals
Understand the difference between UI and UX, user-centred design, common designer responsibilities and the end-to-end design process.
User research
Identify target users, create personas, surface pain points and map user journeys using structured research methods.
Information architecture
Organise content, navigation and user flows so users can find and complete important tasks efficiently.
Wireframing
Create low-fidelity and high-fidelity wireframes for websites, mobile applications, dashboards and digital products.
UI design principles
Apply typography, colour, grids, spacing, hierarchy, contrast and consistency to modern interface design.
Figma workflow
Use frames, layers, components, variants, auto layout, constraints, styles, assets and collaboration features.
Responsive design and prototyping
Design across desktop, tablet and mobile layouts, then connect screens into interactive prototypes.
Design systems
Build reusable components, typography and colour rules, buttons, forms, cards and navigation patterns.
Usability testing
Test designs, collect feedback, identify friction and improve the user experience based on findings.
projects: Website UI/UX project
Design a website from research and wireframes through final interface screens and an interactive prototype.
Mobile app design project
Create a multi-screen mobile experience with navigation, account flows and reusable interface components.
Dashboard or e-commerce project
Design a data-rich dashboard or shopping journey with clear hierarchy, interaction patterns and responsive behaviour.
faq: Is coding required to start UI/UX Design?
No advanced coding knowledge is required. The verified Groot Academy course material focuses on research, wireframing, interface design, Figma, prototyping, design systems and usability testing.
Will I learn Figma?
Yes. The current Groot Academy UI/UX course material includes Figma for interface design, reusable components, auto layout, prototyping and collaboration.

name: Graphic Design
description: Learn Graphic Design in Jaipur with design principles, typography, colour, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, branding, digital creatives and portfolio-focused project practice at Groot Academy.
intro: Build a practical graphic-design workflow from visual fundamentals to software-based execution. Learn how typography, colour, layout and brand thinking connect with Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and portfolio projects for print and digital media.
audience: Students, beginners, marketing professionals, entrepreneurs and aspiring designers who want practical visual-design skills. Prior design software experience is not required.
modules: Graphic design foundations
Understand the role of graphic design, the design process, visual communication, composition and core design principles.
Typography, colour and layout
Practise hierarchy, font selection, spacing, grids, colour theory and layout decisions for clear visual communication.
Adobe Photoshop
Work with raster graphics, selections, layers, image correction, compositing and digital creative workflows.
Adobe Illustrator
Create vector artwork, icons, logos, illustrations and scalable brand assets.
Adobe InDesign and page layout
Explore structured layouts for brochures, flyers and other multi-page or print-oriented design work.
Branding and identity
Develop visual identity concepts such as logos, colour systems, typography choices and supporting brand assets.
Print and digital design
Adapt design principles for posters, social-media graphics, marketing creatives and print-ready communication.
Portfolio workflow
Select, refine and present project work so the design process and final outcomes are easy to understand.
projects: Brand identity mini-project
Create a logo direction, colour palette, typography system and supporting brand applications for a sample brief.
Digital campaign creative set
Design a coordinated set of social or promotional graphics while maintaining hierarchy and visual consistency.
Brochure or poster project
Plan and execute a print-oriented layout using typography, imagery and reusable design structure.
faq: Which tools are covered in the Graphic Design learning path?

The verified source material includes Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign together with typography, colour, layout, branding and portfolio development. Confirm the exact software versions and exercises for the selected batch.
Do I need previous design experience?
No. The course is suitable for beginners as well as learners who want to improve practical visual-design skills.

name: Software Testing
description: Learn Software Testing in Jaipur with testing fundamentals, test cases, defect reporting, web testing, API testing, automation concepts and QA workflows at Groot Academy.
intro: Learn how software quality is checked systematically from requirements to release. Practise test planning, test cases, defect reporting, web and API testing, then understand where automation fits into a broader quality-assurance workflow.
audience: Students, graduates, developers and career changers interested in software quality assurance. Basic computer and web knowledge is enough to begin.
modules: Testing foundations
Understand software quality, SDLC, STLC, test levels and common testing types.
Requirements and test design
Turn requirements into scenarios, test cases, expected results and traceable coverage.
Defect lifecycle
Write reproducible bug reports, use severity and priority correctly and verify fixes.
Web and database checks
Test forms, validation, browser behaviour and basic data-related scenarios.
API testing
Understand requests, responses, status codes and structured checks for service endpoints.
Automation overview
Learn where automation is useful and how tools such as Selenium or Playwright fit into a QA strategy.
projects: Website QA project
Create a test plan, execute functional checks and produce a structured defect report for a sample web application.
API test collection
Build and document a small set of API checks with expected responses and negative test cases.
faq: Does the Software Testing course include manual testing?
Yes. Manual testing foundations, test cases, defect reporting and exploratory checks are part of the core learning path before automation concepts.
Will I also learn automation testing?
The course introduces automation strategy and common tools. Dedicated automation, Selenium and Playwright pages can provide deeper tool-specific learning paths.
